items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Sometimes we had Sonny Greer. A couple times we had some extra musicians

ctx.x: 'One Meatball,' yeah, that was such a big hit.

Yeah, I made those. And then I guess he changed record companies. I wasn't working with him steadily, you know, different periods of time. And then he went to Elektra records and made most of his Elektra records. Sometimes we had Sonny Greer. A couple times we had some extra musicians, basically just he and I. And we traveled and played colleges.

That's a funny one, the colleges we played. We -- am I getting lengthy? We had a date in Syracuse one winter, and we were supposed to leave at 10:00 o'clock in the morning to go to Syracuse. And this day it's snowing and sleeting like crazy, you know, and all the announcers are telling you, if you do have to drive, stay home and all this.
